# Module `lune_ui_winit::input`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_winit`](index.md)

The input seam on winit: [`Translator`](input.md#struct.Translator) turns `WindowEvent`s into [`RawInput`](../lune-ui-core/input.md#struct.RawInput), and
[`OutputState`](input.md#struct.OutputState) applies a [`FrameOutput`](../lune-ui-core/input.md#struct.FrameOutput) to the window. One of each per window.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-winit/src/input.rs:1`

Applies a window's [`FrameOutput`](../lune-ui-core/input.md#struct.FrameOutput), touching the cursor and the IME only when they changed.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-winit/src/input.rs:379`

**Methods and associated items**

`impl OutputState`

- <a id="method.OutputState.apply"></a>`pub fn apply(&mut self, window: &Window, out: &FrameOutput, ui_scale: f32) -> bool`

  Applies `out` to `window`. `ui_scale` is the scale the frame was laid out at (the display's
  scale times the page's zoom): the IME area leaves in physical pixels, [`ime_area_physical`](input.md#fn.ime_area_physical).
  Returns true when the frame asked to close the window (the app closes it).

- <a id="method.OutputState.new"></a>`pub fn new() -> Self`

  A state that has set no cursor and no IME area yet.

- <a id="method.OutputState.plan_output"></a>`pub fn plan_output(&self, out: &FrameOutput) -> OutputPlan`

  What `out` changes against the state the last [`Self::apply`](input.md#method.OutputState.apply) left. Pure: it reads no
  window and changes nothing, so it is tested without one.

<a id="struct.Translator"></a>
### Struct `Translator`

```rust
pub struct Translator {
    // some fields omitted
}
```

Collects one window's winit events into [`RawInput`](../lune-ui-core/input.md#struct.RawInput) frames.

Positions and sizes are divided by the latest scale factor. Events that arrive before the
first pointer move carry the position (0, 0). The window starts unfocused until winit says
otherwise. A hovered, cancelled or dropped file becomes a file event (one per file) at the last
pointer position, in logical pixels: winit gives none. Touch, gestures, theme, moved, occluded,
axis motion and touchpad pressure events are ignored.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-winit/src/input.rs:31`

## Functions

<a id="fn.control_flow"></a>
### Function `control_flow`

```rust
pub fn control_flow(
    repaint: lune_ui_core::input::Repaint,
    origin: std::time::Instant,
) -> (winit::event_loop::ControlFlow, bool)
```

The event loop's control flow for a frame's [`Repaint`](../lune-ui-core/input.md#enum.Repaint), and whether to request a redraw now:
`Idle` waits for input, `Now` waits and asks for a redraw, `At(t)` waits until `origin + t`,
where `origin` is the instant the app's time `0` was taken (a `t` too far to represent waits
for input). Reads no clock.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-winit/src/input.rs:333`

<a id="fn.ime_area_physical"></a>
### Function `ime_area_physical`

```rust
pub fn ime_area_physical(
    area: lune_ui_core::paint::Rect,
    ui_scale: f32,
) -> Option<(f32, f32, f32, f32)>
```

The IME area `area`, which the frame measured in the units of the UI's own scale, as the window
takes it: `(x, y, w, h)` in physical pixels, `area * ui_scale`. `None` when the area or the
scale is not finite, or the scale is not above 0: nothing is sent for it.

The UI's scale is the display's scale times the page's zoom, so under a zoom the area is not
in the window's own logical units; physical pixels are the one unit both agree on.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-winit/src/input.rs:352`

The keyboard conventions of the platform this adapter was built for: `Keymap::MAC` on macOS,
`Keymap::PC` elsewhere. The app passes it in `FrameConfig` (the core never reads the OS, D7).
